name: Avatares AI - Asset Pipeline Orchestrator - Manifest Catalog Validation

workflowId.cachedResultName: Avatares AI - Register Raw Asset Batch - Callable
Avatares AI - Promote Canonical Asset - Callable
Avatares AI - Get Canonical Asset - Callable

parameters.query:
SELECT
  '{{ $json.inputDir.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS input_dir,
  '{{ $json.processedDir.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS processed_dir,
  '{{ $json.duplicatesDir.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS duplicates_dir,
  '{{ $json.failedDir.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS failed_dir,
  '{{ $json.baseUrl.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS base_url,
  '{{ $json.manifestFileName.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS manifest_file_name,
  '{{ $json.manifestSourceFile.name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS manifest_source_file_name,
  '{{ $json.manifestSourceFile.directory.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS manifest_source_file_directory,

  '{{ $json.avatar.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS avatar,
  '{{ $json.avatarShort.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS avatar_short,
  '{{ $json.scene.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS scene,
  '{{ $json.assetType.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS asset_type,
  '{{ $json.workflow.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS workflow,
  '{{ $json.model.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS model,
  {{ $json.seed === null || $json.seed === undefined ? 'NULL' : $json.seed }} AS seed,
  {{ $json.version === null || $json.version === undefined ? 1 : $json.version }} AS version,
  '{{ ($json.parentAssetId || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS parent_asset_id,
  {{ $json.autoPromoteLatest === false ? 'false' : 'true' }} AS auto_promote_latest,

  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM avatar_catalog
    WHERE avatar = '{{ $json.avatar.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
      AND is_active = true
  ) AS avatar_exists,

  (
    SELECT avatar_short
    FROM avatar_catalog
    WHERE avatar = '{{ $json.avatar.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
      AND is_active = true
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS catalog_avatar_short,

  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM scene_catalog
    WHERE avatar = '{{ $json.avatar.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
      AND scene = '{{ $json.scene.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
      AND is_active = true
  ) AS scene_exists,

  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM asset_type_catalog
    WHERE asset_type = '{{ $json.assetType.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
      AND is_active = true
  ) AS asset_type_exists,

  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM generation_catalog
    WHERE workflow = '{{ $json.workflow.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
      AND model = '{{ $json.model.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
      AND is_active = true
  ) AS generation_exists;
